transcript: Speaker A: Kismat mein ek housewife banna hi likha tha, par maine apni kismat badal di. Raat ko 11:00 baje bacchon ko sula ke, chulha-chauka saaf karke, finally main serial dekhne baithti thi. Dinbhar ghar ka kaam, saari jimmedariyan, par apni pehchaan ke baare mein sochte-sochte ek din laga, aisa kab tak chalega? Tab meri saheli Meena ne kaha, roz 15 minute English seekh, warna zindagi bhar bacche aur sasural mein hi simat kar reh jaogi. Sach bataun toh English se darr lagta tha. School mein topper thi, par 8 saal ghar mein baithkar sab bhool gayi. Pati ki office ki party mein sab English mein baat karte the aur main bas haan-haan karti thi. Beti ke PTM mein teacher English mein bolti, main chup khadi rehti. Apne hi ghar mein bacchon ka homework nahi kara paati thi kyunki English nahi aati thi. Phir mujhe English Seekho app dikha. App kholte hi spoken English ka poora show saamne tha. Chote-chote video, seedhi-saadi Hindi mein samjhane ka tareeka, bas wahi dekhkar shuruat kar di. Aur ek AI coach hai jo 24 ghante uplabdh hai. Raat ko bacchon ko sulakar usse chat karke practice karti thi. Galat likhti toh sudhar deta, 100 baar sudhar diya, kabhi nahi bola ki umr ho gayi hai, tumse nahi hoga, saas jaisi nahi thi woh. Pehli raat ek line bola, 'I am Pooja. I have a daughter. I want to restart my career.' Subah aaina dekha, pehli baar khud par vishwas hua. Ghar ke kaam ke beech bhi apni English ko sudharte dekha. Ab meri aadat ban gayi hai, raat 11:00 baje hota hai English time. 15 minute English Seekho app aur agle din ek nayi line. 3 mahine baad work from home job mil gayi, ₹18,000 mahina. Ghar bhi sambhalti hoon aur apna paisa bhi kamati hoon. Par sabse bada fark, beti ka homework ab main karwati hoon. Beti dekhti hai aur muskurati hai. Pati ne kal bola, 'Tu college wali Pooja waapas aa gayi?' Maine bola, 'Nahi, college wali se behtar, kyunki is baar maine khud ko khud banaya hai.' Agar aap bhi sirf gharwali bankar nahi rehna chahtin, ek cheez yaad rakhna, English Seekho se seekhogi toh hi badlogi. Install Now par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. Trial sirf ₹1 ka hai, pehle 15 minute karke dekho, agar pasand aaye toh aage badho. [If your destiny was to be a housewife, you can change it. I used to watch serials late at night after chores. My friend advised me to learn English for 15 minutes daily. I was a school topper but forgot everything over 8 years. I felt left out at my husband's office parties and daughter's PTMs. Then I found the English Seekho app. It has simple Hindi videos and a 24/7 AI coach that corrected my mistakes patiently. I started practicing daily. Within 3 months, I got a work-from-home job earning ₹18,000/month and can now help my daughter with homework. Click Install Now to download. The trial is just ₹1 for the first 15 minutes.] Speaker B: Install Now par click karo aur abhi English Seekho app download karo. [Click Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
